precision_note: Official HF model-default cache stores the FP32 recurrence result as BF16 at each forward boundary. TokenSpeed keeps recurrent state in FP32. BF16 model weights alone therefore do not make these runs state-precision-equivalent. This cache distinction was diagnosed after these runs; it was not a separate cache-dtype setting in their original reports.
status_note: Original numerical and protocol status fields are preserved. The legacy protocol_scope_complete field checked fixture/run scope and did not certify equal recurrent-state precision. Failed rounds remain failed; the thresholds have not been relaxed.
